texts.label: text
texts.orig: Suppose that there are k decision variables and n individuals and we denote by x.l the opinion of individual j as to the most appropriate value of variable i. In many of these problems (such as the allocation of a fixed sum of money among k competing projects) the column sums of the matrix (x.l) are required to have a common value s. If a group adopts as the consensual value of variable i the weighted arithmetic average x.l = W1.l1 + W2.l2 +···+ W.l.l the consensual values have the highly desirable property x.l + x2+···+x.k = 5. The above results assert that weighted arithmetic means are the only averaging functions with this property.
